tools.name: browser_navigate
tools.description: Open a URL in the current tab of your Browser, a Chrome your person can also see and use.

tools.name: browser_back
tools.description: Go back one page in the current tab.

tools.name: browser_snapshot
tools.description: Read the current page as an accessibility tree. Interactive elements carry refs such as e12 for the other tools.

tools.name: browser_click
tools.description: Click the element with this ref from the last snapshot.

tools.name: browser_type
tools.description: Type text into the element with this ref, replacing what it holds. With submit, press Enter after.

tools.name: browser_press
tools.description: Press a key or a chord, such as Enter, Escape, ArrowDown or Control+A.

tools.name: browser_select
tools.description: Choose options, by value or label, in the select element with this ref.

tools.name: browser_scroll
tools.description: Scroll the page by dy pixels; negative scrolls up.

tools.name: browser_screenshot
tools.description: See the current tab as a JPEG image.

tools.name: browser_tabs
tools.description: List, open, switch to or close tabs. index is a tab's number from list; close without it closes the current tab.

tools.name: browser_wait
tools.description: Wait until text appears on the page, or for ms milliseconds. At most 30000 ms.
